patch_resolves_note: The authoritative fixed image reaches the same EXIF post-read and memcpy events on the original PoC, but `data` is refreshed from the post-realloc buffer before the sink, so the required root predicate is genuine and the run is clean.

root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before the EXIF copy path can consume `data`, `read_chunks_before_idat()` must refresh `data` from `ctx->data` after `read_chunk_bytes(ctx, chunk.length)` so the local alias still names the live stream buffer.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original snapshots `data = ctx->data` before the body read and never refreshes it. In the verified vulnerable run the post-read event still has `data` equal to the old buffer while `ctx->data` names the new realloc result; the fixed original reaches the same protected event with both pointers equal because it assigns `data = ctx->data` after the body read.

nodes.description: At the EXIF memcpy sink, the source argument `data` is not the live `ctx->data` buffer in the vulnerable execution, so the sink reads through the stale alias.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records distinct `source_ptr` and `ctx_data_ptr` values at `exif_memcpy`.

nodes.description: The streaming read-growth path reallocates the chunk buffer to a different address, so the old aliased stream buffer becomes the freed object named by ASan's free stack.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records different `old_buffer_ptr` and `new_buffer_ptr` values at `stream_realloc`.

edges.relation: The stale local `data` pointer observed at the protected post-read event is passed unchanged as the EXIF `memcpy()` source argument.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable trace records the same `data_ptr` value at `post_body_read` and as `source_ptr` at `exif_memcpy`.

edges.relation: The old stream-buffer pointer passed into `spng__realloc()` is still the value held in local `data` when `read_chunks_before_idat()` returns from `read_chunk_bytes()`.
